phase: Skins+Recharge Phase A - Permanent Skin Ownership Foundation
source_facts: MID60 SKIN_ON is dual-purpose for Girls: new permanent skin activation consumes one physical item and unlocks ownership while preserving the currently equipped skin; already-owned skin selection uses the same MID60 to equip/switch without item consumption.
MID61 SKIN_CANCEL unequips the active Girl skin without removing permanent ownership.
BackpackWindow blocks Spend for an already-owned permanent skin before sending MID60.
NormalHero/SuperHero serialize permanent skin ownership as model_id -> -1 when map-shaped and preserve timed skin expiries separately.
MID60/MID61 are also reused by PetAttributeWindow0 with a different Pet skin response contract; Pet skin handling is outside Girl Phase A and must fail closed here.
skin_skill.lua defines 262 canonical permanent Girl skins across 212 Girls; 225 have skin skills and 37 are cosmetic-only.
correction_to_pass144_plan: New physical skin activation unlocks ownership but does NOT auto-equip; HeroMainWindow explicitly retains the existing current skin. Equip/switch is the already-owned MID60 branch.
epistemic: SOURCE_FACT except fail-closed implementation boundaries, which are IMPLEMENTATION/COMPATIBILITY_DECISION
